title: Active maintenance: a guide
description: A step-by-step guide to actively maintaining the replication archive of a published article: checking the original archive, building a ground truth of every published claim, rewriting the code so it runs on current software, checking the claims, writing errata, and publishing the maintained version. It includes decision rules for what counts as an erratum, the schema of every output table, and instructions written for AI coding agents. Rendered at https://active-maintenance-aec.github.io/guide/. This record's concept DOI always resolves to the latest version.
